answer: Work slots in the agent economy are rented from a shared orchard. Each agent pays a 30-credit copper deposit to hold one slot, refunded only after verified delivery. Pearl jobs, the top tasks, go only to slots with a clean record. An attacker renting 100 fake slots burns 100 x 30 = 3,000 credits, and failed deliveries forfeit the deposit. Honest agents pay once, deliver once, and keep the full reward plus their deposit.
